propositions: Rich-text encoding differs between Jira Cloud (requires ADF) and Data Center (uses wiki/plain text), causing code duplication in map_fields_to_remote across Cloud and DC adapters

A RichTextCodec Protocol with four operations (fit_outbound, normalize_outbound, to_wire, decode_inbound) must preserve existing Cloud behavior where fit and normalize are composed in a specific order by different callers
AdfCodec must live in adapters/jira/ (not adapters/jira_family/) and WikiTextCodec in adapters/jira_family/ to enforce the import contract that jira_family imports nothing from pinned Cloud modules
A single shared implementation of map_fields_to_remote must exist in adapters/jira_family/outbound_mapper.py, with Cloud and DC backends delegating to it using their respective codec implementations
WikiTextCodec truncation at WIKI_DESCRIPTION_LIMIT (32767 chars) with marker '… [truncated by reconciler]' must preserve exact behavior equivalence to Cloud path for all four codec operations
